changelog: Client companies are now the primary Clients view, with separate Companies and Contacts navigation and a visible Add company action
On narrower screens, the company and contact forms appear before long client lists so administrators can add records without searching below the list
Workspace administrators can set one default language while users inherit it or keep a personal preference
The language profile now clearly distinguishes a workspace default from a user-specific override
Microsoft 365 and Outlook mailboxes can connect through OAuth2 for inbound tickets and outbound notifications without storing the mailbox password
Microsoft Graph credentials and refresh tokens are encrypted at rest, with independent inbound and outbound controls
Report previews now keep real tracked time separate from optional billable rounding
The self-hosted release boundary now rejects private SaaS routes and backend modules
Migration parity now uses stable semantic IDs and verified checksums
FoxDesk now ships complete runtime catalogs for 24 locales
Arabic, Hebrew, Persian, and Urdu receive right-to-left layout, bidi isolation, and semantic directional icons
Chinese, Japanese, and Korean input now respects IME composition and CJK-aware search behavior
Locale-aware dates, numbers, plurals, fonts, e-mails, reports, and public views are available throughout the application
Language identifiers now support canonical regional and script tags such as pt-BR, zh-Hans, and zh-Hant
Translation catalog, placeholder, plural, CSS direction, and generated-file checks are enforced by the release pipeline
